# Mobile-only Content

`email/mobile-only` &middot; section-level &middot; category: email

## Purpose

Sections that only show on phones. Hidden in clients that ignore media queries.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | components (section-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Hidden on desktop, shown below 480px.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |


## Responsive behavior

No dedicated responsive settings. It follows the width of the column or section it sits in.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Never shown (Outlook desktop ignores media queries), by design. | Shown on phones. Stays hidden in Gmail on non-Google accounts. | Nothing extra, the sections inside carry their own colors. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('email/mobile-only', {
  "content": [
    {
      "component": "layout/section",
      "data": {
        "content": [
          {
            "component": "content/button",
            "data": {
              "label": "Tap to shop on the app",
              "href": "https://example.com/app"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "email/mobile-only",
  "data": {
    "content": [
      {
        "component": "layout/section",
        "data": {
          "content": [
            {
              "component": "content/button",
              "data": {
                "label": "Tap to shop on the app",
                "href": "https://example.com/app"
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
